# Zices

> Documentation for DocFGP, neo4j-guard, and Chartable, the Python and JavaScript libraries by Zices @iamzices.

## DocFGP

DocFGP by Zices is a Python library that creates text and visual fingerprints for finding duplicates, near-duplicates, and shared passages across document formats. It supports exact, near-duplicate, and partial-match retrieval, with OCR and visual fingerprints for scanned documents.

- [What is DocFGP?](https://docs.zices.com/docfgp/overview): DocFGP by Zices is a Python library that creates text and visual fingerprints for finding duplicates, near-duplicates, and shared passages across document formats.
- [Quick start](https://docs.zices.com/docfgp/quick-start): Install DocFGP by Zices, fingerprint a PDF, DOCX, PPTX, or scanned document, and compare fingerprints to find duplicates, near-duplicates, and shared passages.
- [API reference](https://docs.zices.com/docfgp/api-reference): API reference for DocFGP by Zices: Fingerprinter, DocumentFingerprint, FingerprintConfig, FingerprintError, supported formats, and the docfgp CLI.

## neo4j-guard

neo4j-guard by Zices is a Python library that blocks unsafe Cypher queries before execution. It parses Cypher using ANTLR and Neo4j's Cypher 25 grammar, then traverses the resulting syntax tree to validate query operations against built-in safety rules.

- [What is neo4j-guard?](https://docs.zices.com/neo4j-guard/overview): neo4j-guard by Zices is a Python library that blocks unsafe Cypher queries before they reach Neo4j. Read-only by default.
- [Quick start](https://docs.zices.com/neo4j-guard/quick-start): Install neo4j-guard by Zices and guard a Neo4j driver, LangChain Neo4jGraph, or the Neo4j MCP server with guard().
- [API reference](https://docs.zices.com/neo4j-guard/api-reference): API reference for neo4j-guard by Zices: guard(), GuardError, mode defaults, and the allow and disallow entries.

## Chartable

Chartable by Zices is an easy to use interactive chart and table JavaScript library built on Plotly.js and Tabulator. Every chart and table has buttons to copy and download its data.

- [What is Chartable?](https://docs.zices.com/chartable/overview): Chartable by Zices is an easy to use JavaScript library that draws interactive charts and tables, with copy and CSV download, built on Plotly.js and Tabulator.
- [Quick start](https://docs.zices.com/chartable/quick-start): Install Chartable by Zices and render an interactive bar chart with render().
- [API reference](https://docs.zices.com/chartable/api-reference): API reference for Chartable by Zices: render(), ChartableSpec, Cell, column mapping, and copy and CSV download.

## Blog

- [How to add guardrails for LLM-generated Cypher](https://docs.zices.com/blog/add-guardrails-for-llm-generated-cypher): Guard the Neo4j driver with guard() from neo4j-guard by Zices, then run the LLM's queries through it. Dangerous queries raise GuardError.
- [What read-only doesn't protect when AI agents access Neo4j](https://docs.zices.com/blog/neo4j-read-only-ai-agents): Read-only blocks writes, but not queries that read sensitive data, send data out, fetch instructions, or overload Neo4j. neo4j-guard by Zices covers the gaps.
- [Moment by Zices Is a Privacy-First, Peer-to-Peer Chat That Disappears When You Leave](https://docs.zices.com/blog/moment-privacy-first-peer-to-peer-chat): Moment by Zices is a private, temporary peer-to-peer chat room with file sharing. There is no login, and Moment never sees what you send.
- [Moment by Zices Might Be the Easiest Way to Move Anything Between Two Computers](https://docs.zices.com/blog/moment-move-anything-between-two-computers): Open a Moment by Zices room on one computer and its short link on the other to easily share files. Moment is a private, temporary peer-to-peer chat room.
- [How to deduplicate documents with DocFGP](https://docs.zices.com/blog/deduplicate-documents-with-docfgp): A short, hands-on tutorial that uses DocFGP by Zices to find the duplicates in a folder of PDFs, Word files, slides, and scans.
- [Is this DOCX the same as that PDF? How to match documents across formats with DocFGP](https://docs.zices.com/blog/match-documents-across-formats): How to check whether a DOCX, PPTX, PDF, or scanned document has the same content as another file, with short DocFGP by Zices examples.
- [When to use DocFGP instead of file hashes](https://docs.zices.com/blog/docfgp-vs-file-hashes): What file hashes miss when you compare documents, and when DocFGP by Zices is the better way to find duplicates.
- [DocFGP now supports scanned documents in 100+ languages](https://docs.zices.com/blog/docfgp-scanned-documents-100-languages): DocFGP by Zices can now read and compare scanned documents in more than 100 languages, including Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Russian, and Hindi. Here is how to set it up.
